prompt: Finance reports penny drift when splitting order-level discounts across 3 equal items (for example 100 cents across three $10 items allocates 99 cents instead of 100) and crashes/NaN when the items list is empty with a 0-cent discount. Diagnose and fix `src/allocator.mjs` so total allocated discount ALWAYS equals `totalDiscountCents` using integer arithmetic (largest-remainder distribution; deterministic tie-breaking by item order), never makes `netCents` negative, and handles empty lists with 0 discount cleanly while preserving existing error checks and `formatCents`.
